paite: "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh belam huang kongkhak a lut lou a, lampi dang a kahlutmi guta leh suamhat ahi.
heading: Belamchingpa Gentehna

paite: Kuapeuh kongkhak a lut belamchingpa ahi.
Kongkhak ngakpa'n amah ana honsak a; belamte'n a-aw aza uh; ama'n belamte amin un asam chiat a, apikhe zel hi.
Amah a tengteng apawtsaktak in, ama uh akai a, belamte'n amah azui zel ua, a-aw athei uhi.
Midang azui kei ding ua, ataimangsan zaw ding uh; midangte aw atheih louh ziak un,” achi hi.
Hiai gentehna Jesu'n akiang uah agen hi; himahleh bang thu ahia akiang ua agen chih athei kei uhi.
Huchi in Jesu'n akiang uah agen nawn a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kei belam kongkhak ka hi.
heading: Jesu Belamchingpa Hoih

paite: Ka ma a hong pai tengteng gutate leh suamhatte ahi vek uh; himahleh belamte'n athu uh angaihsak kei uh.
Kei kongkhak ka hi; keimah a mi alutleh, humbit in a-om ding a, alut in apawt dia, nek ding leng amu ding hi.
Guta zaw, gu ding leh that ding leh hihse ding lou in ahong pai kei; kei ka hihleh hinna aneihna ding ua, tampitak aneihna ding ua hong pai ka hi.
"Kei belamchingpa hoih ka hi; belamchingpa hoih in abelamte a ding in ahinna apia hi.
Kilohmi, belamchingpa tak hilou, belamte amah a hilou in, ngia hong pai amuh in belamte ataisan a; huan ngia in amau akei a, huchi in belamte ahihdalh hi.
Kilohmi ahi a, belamte a ding a deihsakna himhim aneih louh ziak in ataimang hi.
Kei zaw belamchingpa hoih ka hi.
Pa in ahon theih bang in ke'n leng Pa ka thei hi, huan belamte a ding in ka hinna ka pia hi.
Hiai belam huang a lou belam dangte ka nei hi; amau leng ka hon pi ding a, ka aw aza ding ua, hon khat in chingpa khat toh a-omkhawm ding uhi.
"Hiai ziak in Pa'n kei ahon it ahi; lak nawn ding a ka hinna ka piak ding ziak in.
Kuamah in hon laksak kei ding, keimah thuthu in ka pe zaw ding hi. Pe thei ka hi a, la nawn thei leng ka hi. Hiai thupiak ka Pa a pan ka muh ahi,” achi hi.
Hiai thu ziak in Judate akikhen ua, akilang nawnta uhi.
Akhen tampi in, "Dawi zawl ahi, ahai ei ve; bangziak a athu ngaikhia na hi ua?" achi uhi.
Akhen in, "Hiai dawi zawl thute hi kei e. Dawi in mittaw mit ahihvak thei a hia?" achi uhi.
Huan Jerusalem a Latna Ankuanglui lai ahi a, huai hun phalbi lai ahi.
heading: Jesu Nawlkhin In A-om

paite: Tempul, Solomon inlim ah Jesu akivialleh hi.
Judate'n hong umkual ua, akiang ah, "Bang tan lakloh tak a hon koih ding na hia? Khrist na hihleh chiantak in hon hilh in," achi uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hon hilhta a, na gingta tuan kei uh; ka Pa min a thil ka hih hiaite'n ka tanchin atheisak uhi.
Himahleh na gingta kei uhi, ka belam lak a mi na hih louh ziak un.
Ka belamte'n ka aw aza uh, ke'n leng amaute ka thei a, amau ahon zui uhi.
Akiang uah tangtawn hinna ka pia; tangtawn in amangthang himhim kei ding ua, kuamah in ka khut a kipan hon sut sam kei ding hi.
Amau hon pepa ka Pa, mi tengteng sang a thupizaw ahi; kuamah in Pa khut a kipan asut thei kei ding hi.
Kei leh Pa lah pum khat ka hi uh," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Judate'n adenna ding in suang atawm nawn uhi.
heading: Judate'n Jesu Ahua Uh

paite: Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, "Pa a kipan nasep hoih tampi ka hon ensak a, huai nasepte lak ah bang nasep ziak in ahia suang a na hon den dek uh?" achi hi.
Judate'n akiang ah, "Nasep hoih ziak in suang in ka hon dengdek kei uh; Pathian na gensiat ziak leh nang mihing hi ngal a, Pathian a na kibawl ziak ahi zaw," chi in adawng uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na dan uah, 'noute pathiante na hi uh ka hon chi,' chih gelh ahi kei a hia?
Pathian thu tunnate bawn pathiante achihleh Laisiangthou bohsiat theih ahi kei hi.
Pathian Tapa ka hi, ka chih ziak in Pa'n aseh a, khovel a asawlpa Pathian na gensia hon chi na hi uh maw?
Ka Pa nasem ka hih keileh hon gingta kei un.
Himahleh sem ka hihleh kei hon gingta kei mah le uchin ka nasepte bek gingta un; huchi a keimah ah Pa a-om chih leh kei Pa ah ka om chih na theihna ua, na theihsiamna ding un," chi in adawng hi.
Huaitak in mat atum nawn ua, himahleh akhut ua kipan asuakta hi.
Jordan lui gal ah Johan in atung a mi abaptisna lam ah apaimang nawn a, huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Huan akiang ah mi tampi ahong pai ua, "Johan in thillamdang bangmah ahih kei a; himahleh Johan in hiai mi tungtang thu agen peuhmah ana dik mahmah hi," achi uhi.
Huan huai ah mi tampi in amah agingta uhi.
